A.explanation: Extended sources can blur a pattern, but the fundamental reason two separate lamps give no stable pattern is lack of coherence.

B.explanation: Different amplitudes would change fringe contrast but would still allow constructive and destructive superposition if the phase relation were fixed.

C.explanation: Two independent lamps emit with randomly changing phase difference, so no stable interference fringes can form on the screen.

D.explanation: White light contains many wavelengths and gives coloured fringes with a white central fringe, so whiteness alone does not prevent interference.
